主要内容: Spotify reported its first-half 2017 earnings, showing growing revenue and improved margins. The company's revenue reached $2.2 billion, with a year-over-year growth target of 40% by the end of the year. Gross margins increased to 22% from 15% in 2016. However, Spotify continued to operate at a loss, with an estimated operating loss between 100 million and 200 million euros ($118.4 million and $236.8 million). Despite the losses, private investors are more optimistic about Spotify's future, with its estimated market value rising to about $16 billion from $13 billion earlier in the year. The company is not publicly traded, but there are reports suggesting it may consider a public listing in the near future. Better deals with music labels may have contributed to the improved financial performance, but Spotify has not commented on the matter.
